title: One change per iteration
text:
Symptom / ask: Fix failed after changing many knobs at once.
Cause: Shotgun edits (prompt + pad + LoRA + sharpen + resize together) hide which change helped or hurt.
Do: Change one variable per iteration; keep a baseline; compare before stacking.
Don't: Bundle unrelated pipeline or UI tweaks in the same experiment.
Pointer: usable in any debugging / ML tuning / RE bisect loop.

title: Commit and push only when asked
text:
Symptom / ask: Agent created commits or pushed without request.
Cause: Over-eager automation treating 'done' as 'commit'.
Do: Commit/push only when the user explicitly asks; draft message from diff when asked.
Don't: Auto-commit WIP, secrets, or .env files.
Pointer: applies to every repo.

title: Prefer code over stale status banners
text:
Symptom / ask: Docs say 'not built' but the feature works (or the reverse).
Cause: README status lines lag implemented routes and flags.
Do: Verify behavior in source (routes, flags, tests) when docs and code conflict.
Don't: Train or answer solely from outdated 'status' banners.
Pointer: any multi-doc codebase.

title: No secrets or real hostnames in RAG seeds
text:
Symptom / ask: Tokens, Tailscale IPs, or passwords appear in training corpora.
Cause: Copying live .env into docs/seeds.
Do: Use placeholders and .env.example; omit real hostnames/secrets from RAG corpora.
Don't: Commit or embed live credentials into seed markdown/JSONL.
Pointer: every project seed pack.

title: Don't learn vague 'please paste the file' answers
text:
Symptom / ask: coding_lessons retrieves useless turns that ask the user to paste files.
Cause: Auto-learn saved incomplete local answers as lessons.
Do: Learn only verified fixes with concrete do/don't; demote or delete low-signal rows.
Don't: Treat every completed chat as a durable lesson.
Pointer: Blossom coding_lessons hygiene; any auto-RAG memory.
